desc: A collection of field recordings capturing the call to prayer (Adhan) across Fes, Morocco. Recorded on location, these recordings capture the distant voices of different mosques echoing through the city, along with the natural atmosphere and subtle sounds of the surrounding streets and neighbourhoods. Recorded as part of an ongoing field recording project exploring unique places, environments and sounds from around the world. Feel free to use these recordings in music, sound design, film, games, ambient projects and other creative work. More field recordings and sounds can be found for free at signaturesounds.org.
title: Call_To_Prayer_In_The_Distance_Fes_Morocco_
author: SignatureSoundsOrg
